message: "Not on macOS: Linux's leak check is LeakSanitizer's, run on the sanitized binary"
provides: macOS-only counted-build leak witness; Linux uses LeakSanitizer on the sanitized binary.
Requires an FMA-capable arm64 or amd64 CPU; amd64 capability is read from /proc/cpuinfo on Linux or sysctl hw.optional.fma on macOS.

The normal correctness gate must leave ADAMIC_C_COVERAGE unset (or not equal to 1). CoverageRequested in internal/native/native.go reads this variable; forcing coverage on every build prevents the covered/ordinary runtime cache separation proof.

message: "Linux is the gate of record; macOS Node fuses multiply-adds, so navigation.a differs there (#myatdyv), and this lane gets its own Linux shard"
